units.source_text: “她的肩膀太美了，看着她的坐姿，谁都会这么想的。

en.t: “Her shoulders are so beautiful; anyone looking at the way she sits would think so.

units.source_text: 不过，丰姿也是第一流的。

en.t: But her graceful figure is first-rate as well.
Let us have her stand up and take a look.”

units.source_text: 布景画家说着向她招手：“友子，请你站起来看看。”

en.t: As he said this, the set painter beckoned to her: “Tomoko, please stand up and let us see.”
